plan.title: Bulk Counter Offer on Live RFQ

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ with two bids on the buyer's Responses tab.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the setup.
Ensure counter offers are shown on RFQ stages.
Verify the Settings menu offers the action and that it is clickable with two live bids.
Open the bulk counter-offer window without confirming any counter offer.
Confirm the bulk counter-offer window opened.
Close the bulk counter-offer window without submitting changes.
Verify the enabled menu action remains available after cancelling.
